## Changes

- **Filter downloads by size.** The filters in **Downloads In Progress** have a new **Video** section with size chips: **4K**, **1440p**, **1080p**, **720p** and **Below 720p**. Size goes by the video's long side, so a portrait 1080 × 1920 video counts as 1080p, the same as a landscape 1920 × 1080 one.
- **Filter downloads by shape.** Pick **Landscape**, **Portrait** or **Square**. Size and shape work together, so **1080p** with **Portrait** shows portrait 1080p videos only. Pick more than one chip in a row to see any of them; with none picked, that row doesn't filter.
- **Every folder is read.** The include and exclude folder lists are gone: a refresh reads every video in your downloads folder and the folders inside it.
- **Cover suggestions open faster.** Each screenshot's score is now saved on its own, so **Choose for me** only looks at screenshots that are new or rebuilt since, rather than the whole folder again.
- **Rebuilding screenshots scores them too.** With a cover model downloaded, **Rebuild All Screenshots** scores each new screenshot for cover suggestions as it goes, so Choose for me opens straight away afterwards.
- **Saved suggestions are kept until you clear them.** They no longer expire after 30 days or when you change the model or tile shape. **Settings > Covers > Clear saved suggestions** forgets them all, so every screenshot is looked at again with the model chosen then.
